test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 07 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

They all, except Shirin, were very sad / during the farewell party given / to the teacher retiring, and her / indifference were well noticed.

options.text: They all, except Shirin, were very sad
to the teacher retiring, and her

solution:
The correct answer is **'indifference were well noticed'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The auxiliary **'were'** is not appropriate as **'her'** is a third person **singular.**
 
• The right auxiliary should be **'was'**.
 
• Hence this part of the sentence is grammatically incorrect. 

**Correct Sentence:**__ *They all, except Shirin, were very sad / during the farewell party given / to the teacher retiring, and her / indifference **__was__ **well noticed.*
